items.title: Is Vistra (VST) Still Below Fair Value After Data Center Clarity?
items.summary: Vistra has delivered very large gains over the past five years, yet its recent pullback leaves a live question about whether the current share price lines up with the earnings power of the business. With the stock now trading around US$123.87 and sentiment shaped by the power market debate, the issue is what that figure says about the relationship between Vistra's profit stream and its valuation. items.title: How Has Vistra Stock's Story Changed?
items.summary: Vistra stock closed at $123.87 on Monday, November 23. At that price, you pay 7.2 times the cash its operations brought in over the past year. The S&P 500 as a whole trades at 14.8 times on the same measure. Anyone paying that price should know which business management now asks them to own.
